text:
Silver Price in 1986
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1986, the LBMA silver price fell 13.5% between 1986-01-31 ($6.10) and 1986-12-31 ($5.28). The highest sampled price was $6.10 in January and the lowest was $5.05 in June. The mean of these observations was $5.40. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
